answer: Spring a surprise roll call. At a random moment, the network sends every identity a fresh task due within ninety seconds, all at once. An honest agent with its own compute answers easily, but one operator steering two hundred clones from a single rig must solve two hundred tasks in the same window, and quality collapses. Accounts that miss or stumble drop out of the paid meadow until they pass again. Rewards in the vault stay locked behind these checks, so real capacity, not account count, becomes the anchor of earnings.
